title: Limpio y Claro
style: Alternative metal with nu-metal bounce, mid-tempo half-time drums, tight palm-muted guitars, gritty sub-bass, and chopped vocal rhythm. Verse rides tense spoken-sung lines; chorus hits with gang shouts and repeated hook words; bridge pulls to a slower, atmospheric break before snapping back. Close-mic lead vocal, layered doubles on the hook, delay throws on key phrases, glitch clicks and tape crackle as ear candy, bright and punchy mix with a hard-edged low end., tropical, bachata, latin, alternative metal, simple, nu metal
